# Colecto v0.8.2

Every folder of your account, mail older than the newest 100, and steadier menus, tabs
and conversations.

## Mail

- All your folders, Gmail labels included, now sit in the folder bar next to Inbox,
  Drafts and Sent. A message's menu offers the same folders to move it to.
- Scroll to the end of a list to load the next 100 older messages, as far back as the
  folder goes. The end of the list says when it is loading, when there is nothing older,
  or when loading failed, with a button to try again. See
  [Accounts](https://github.com/kogical/colecto/blob/v0.8.2/docs/accounts.md).
- A message's menu opens straight away. Before, the first right-click waited for the
  folder list, which can take seconds over IMAP, so the menu sometimes seemed not to
  open. Right-clicking another message while a menu is open now opens that message's
  menu.

## Reading

- The reader shows where a message sits in its conversation ("Message 2 of 4") with
  **Earlier** and **Later** buttons. Moving through a conversation stays in the same tab,
  keeps the earlier and later messages as you had them, and shows the message at once
  instead of a blank loading screen.
- Scrolling the mouse wheel over the message tabs moves them sideways. Right-click a tab
  for **Close tab** and **Close all tabs**.

## Smaller fixes

- The AI settings page says "Model on" instead of "model on".
- A mail server that resets one folder no longer throws away saved messages of other
  folders.

## For extension authors

Extension API 2 lets mail lists reach every folder and older mail.
`/messages/refresh` and `/messages/cache` take any folder id from `/folders`,
`/messages/refresh` takes `offset` to load an older page, and the `list` component takes
`more` and sends `end` near its end. Extensions on API 1 keep working unchanged. See
[API 2](https://github.com/kogical/colecto/blob/v0.8.2/docs/extensions/api-versions/API-2.md).
